pairingCode.title: Local Operator pairing code
pairingCode.description: Written only by `lop browser setup --node` on a headless node, removed once paired. Never set this by hand.

headlessNode.title: Headless mesh node
headlessNode.description: Written by `lop browser setup --node`: nobody can click the popup on this machine, so site approvals are decided by the operator's signature instead.

operatorAnchorPoint.title: Operator anchor public key
operatorAnchorPoint.description: Hex uncompressed P-256 point copied by `lop browser setup --node` from the root-owned operator anchor; site approvals must be signed by it.

operatorKeyId.title: Operator anchor key id
operatorKeyId.description: First 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over the anchor point; checked against the point.

nodeDeviceId.title: Mesh device id of this node
nodeDeviceId.description: Bound into each signed site approval so a decision for one node cannot be replayed on another.
